name: FOMC rate decision

primary_sources.name: Summary of Economic Projections
extract: federal funds rate medians by year
primary_sources.note: Only published at March, June, September, December meetings

companion.note: Pre-2008 single target, combined with DFEDTARU for full history

computations.description: Count calendar days from the last change point in DFEDTARU to the meeting date
Rank the current upper-bound rate against the full 1982-present DFEDTAR+DFEDTARU daily history (midpoint method)
Count consecutive months where YoY PCE inflation exceeds 2%, ending at the latest pre-meeting reading
Extract change points from DFEDTARU for the step chart

outlet_check.method: Compare each outlet's checkable factual claims against the primary documents
outlet_check.rule: A wrong claim is named plainly: who, what they wrote, what the record shows

grok_scope.constraint: Named officials only, dated URLs required, never verdicts
grok_scope.example: Search for [official name] post about FOMC [date] on X

grok_scope.constraint: Dated primary quotes from FedWatch/Polymarket/Kalshi with source URLs, no estimates
grok_scope.example: Search for CME FedWatch odds [date range] with dated source URLs

grok_scope.constraint: Specific named article that blocked automated capture, disclose recovery in SOURCES.md
grok_scope.example: Fetch [URL] that returned 403 to automated retrieval

subject_page_updates: Append timeline row: date, vote tally, link to new story
Refresh KPI strip: current rate, days held (live counter), vote
Extend chart endpoint to new meeting date

manifest_template.note: Each step requires a real evidence line, not a stub. A false attestation is a false ship.
